editorial: Step into a claustrophobic world where the line between professional curiosity and lethal obsession vanishes. You will find yourself trapped in a suffocating psychological game of cat-and-mouse that weaponizes the written word against the reader. Michael Showalter delivers a masterclass in tension, utilizing a chillingly sterile aesthetic that makes every whispered secret feel like a threat. If you crave a high-stakes puzzle that refuses to give you a straight answer, this is your next obsession.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of domestic noir and unreliable narrators.
